Class BitmapFontAtlas

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Text
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a bitmap font atlas that arranges glyphs into a texture for efficient rendering. Provides methods to generate, draw, and manage the atlas and its glyphs.

Methods

Draw(string, Rect, ColorRgba)

Draws the specified text using the atlas, fitting each character into a grid within the given rectangle. Only characters present in the atlas will be drawn.

public void Draw(string text, Rect rect, ColorRgba color)

Parameters

text string

The text string to render.

rect Rect

The rectangle area where the text will be drawn.

color ColorRgba

The color to apply to the rendered text.

Remarks

Glyphs may be distorted if the grid cell aspect ratio does not match the glyph aspect ratio. Use Draw(string, Rect, ColorRgba, float, float, AnchorPoint) for uniform scaling of glyphs.

Draw(string, Rect, ColorRgba, float, float, AnchorPoint)

Draws the specified text using the atlas, fitting each character into a grid within the given rectangle, and applies custom horizontal and vertical padding to each glyph. Only characters present in the atlas will be drawn.

public void Draw(string text, Rect rect, ColorRgba color, float paddingX, float paddingY, AnchorPoint alignment)

Parameters

text string

The text string to render.

rect Rect

The rectangle area where the text will be drawn.

color ColorRgba

The color to apply to the rendered text.

paddingX float

Horizontal padding to apply to each glyph.

paddingY float

Vertical padding to apply to each glyph.

alignment AnchorPoint

AnchorPoint value where X is between 0 and 1, determining horizontal alignment (0 = left, 1 = right, 0.5 = center), and Y is between 0 and 1 for vertical alignment (0 = top, 1 = bottom, 0.5 = center).

DrawAtlas(Rect, ColorRgba, int)

Draws the entire atlas texture so it fits into the given rectangle, wrapping glyphs to new lines as needed. The glyphs are drawn from top-left to bottom-right, with each glyph placed in order of supportedChars.

public void DrawAtlas(Rect rect, ColorRgba tint, int padding = 8)

Parameters

rect Rect

The rectangle area to fit the atlas into.

tint ColorRgba

The color tint to apply to the atlas texture.

padding int

Optional padding around each glyph to prevent overlap.

DrawAtlas(Vector2, Vector2, ColorRgba)

Draws the entire atlas texture at the specified position and scale, applying the given tint color. The atlas is vertically flipped to match the expected orientation.

public void DrawAtlas(Vector2 position, Vector2 scale, ColorRgba tint)

Parameters

position Vector2

The position on the screen where the atlas will be drawn.

scale Vector2

The scale factor to apply to the atlas texture.

tint ColorRgba

The color tint to apply to the atlas texture.

DrawWithLineWrap(string, Rect, ColorRgba, float, float, bool)

Draws the specified text using the atlas, scaling each glyph uniformly to fit within the given rectangle, and wraps text to new lines as needed. Optionally prevents splitting words across lines. The text is centered and scaled to maintain the glyph aspect ratio. Only characters present in the atlas will be drawn.

public void DrawWithLineWrap(string text, Rect rect, ColorRgba color, float paddingX = 0, float paddingY = 0, bool dontSplitWords = false)

Parameters

text string

The text string to render.

rect Rect

The rectangle area where the text will be drawn.

color ColorRgba

The color to apply to the rendered text.

paddingX float

Absolute horizontal padding to apply to each glyph.

paddingY float

Absolute vertical padding to apply to each glyph.

dontSplitWords bool

If true, words will not be split across lines when wrapping.

GenerateAtlas(ColorRgba, ColorRgba)

Generates the font atlas texture by drawing each glyph with the specified color and background. Throws an exception if the atlas is already generated.

public void GenerateAtlas(ColorRgba glyphColor, ColorRgba backgroundColor)

Parameters

glyphColor ColorRgba

The color to use for glyphs.

backgroundColor ColorRgba

GenerateAtlas(ColorRgba, Action<Rect, bool, char, int, int>)

Generates the font atlas texture using a custom cell drawing action. Throws an exception if the atlas is already generated.

public void GenerateAtlas(ColorRgba backgroundColor, Action<Rect, bool, char, int, int> drawCell)

Parameters

backgroundColor ColorRgba

The background color of the atlas.

drawCell Action<Rect, bool, char, int, int>

An action to draw each cell, with parameters:

  • Rect: The rectangle for the glyph cell.
  • bool: Indicates if the cell is active.
  • char: The character for the glyph.
  • int: The row index.
  • int: The column index.

Unload()

Unloads the atlas texture from memory and marks the atlas as not generated. Safe to call multiple times; does nothing if the atlas is not generated.
